entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: An information element used to encapsulate SMS messages transferred between the UE and the network. It is a type 4 IE with a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 253 octets.

entities.name: NAS message container IEI
entities.description: The information element identifier for the NAS message container, occupying octet 1.

entities.name: Length of NAS message container contents
entities.description: Field indicating the length of the NAS message container contents, occupying octets 2-3.

entities.name: NAS message container contents
entities.description: Field containing the encapsulated SMS message (CP-DATA, CP-ACK, or CP-ERROR) as defined in 3GPP TS 24.011, occupying octets 3 to n.

entities.name: SMS message
entities.description: Encapsulated message within the NAS message container, which can be CP-DATA, CP-ACK, or CP-ERROR as defined in 3GPP TS 24.011.

relations.description: The NAS message container IE includes the IEI field.
The NAS message container IE includes the length field.
The NAS message container IE includes the contents field.
The contents field encapsulates an SMS message (CP-DATA, CP-ACK, or CP-ERROR).
